name: Brandye
summary: Shopify app that adds an AI product-finder quiz, AI-generated questions and answers on product pages and an AI shopping assistant trained on your catalogue, with email capture and sync to Klaviyo and other marketing tools.
best_for: Shopify stores with a catalogue where shoppers genuinely need help choosing, such as skincare, supplements or gifts, that want a product-finder quiz, answers on product pages and a chat assistant in one app, and value a small team that helps set it up
skip_if: you want a free plan to run on for months, because the free allowance is 100 submissions and 100 chats in total; or you sell mainly to shoppers in languages other than English and need that confirmed on the listing; or you only need a quiz, because a dedicated quiz app gives more submissions per dollar
honest_knock:
Read the free plan as a trial, not a tier. Its 100 quiz submissions and 100 chats are lifetime totals, not monthly, so a store with real traffic uses them up in days or weeks and then has to pay. Data retention is the other quiet limit: the free plan keeps 15 days of data and Starter 30, so the quiz answers and chat history you would use to spot patterns over a season are only kept for 90 days on Growth at $129 a month or above.

The Shopify listing shows four plans and stops at $129. The vendor's own pricing page goes on to Scale at $249 and Brand at $599 a month, so a growing store that reads only the listing will not see where the ladder ends. The listing also gives English as the only language, while 11 of its 12 reviews come from French stores and are written in French, so check how the quiz and assistant handle your shoppers' language before you rely on them.

The reviews are uniformly positive but say little that can be checked. Most praise the team as much as the app, naming the founder and describing hands-on help with installing and customising the quiz, and several were written after days or weeks of use. One says conversion went up and returns went down, without figures. The homepage figures of a 16% higher average order value and five times the conversion rate are, by Brandye's own footnote, indicative midpoints of its reported ranges, not measurements we can verify. Brandye's legal page lists quiz responses among the data it collects and says collected data is used, among other things, for marketing and retargeting campaigns; it does not say whether that covers your shoppers' answers or only visitors to brandye.com, so ask before you install if that matters to you. We have not installed the app.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-02 on brandye.com/pricing and on apps.shopify.com/brandye-quiz-ai-recommendation) Every plan includes the product quiz, the AI shopping assistant and AI product questions; the tiers differ in how many quiz submissions and chats you get and how long your data is kept. Free covers up to 100 quiz submissions and 100 chats in total, lifetime rather than per month, with 15 days of data. Starter is $19 a month for 200 submissions and 500 chats a month with 30 days of data. Booster is $49 a month for 500 submissions and 1,500 chats with 60 days. Growth is $129 a month for 1,000 submissions and 3,000 chats with 90 days. Those four are the only plans on the Shopify listing, which shows yearly prices of $190 for Starter, $470.40 for Booster and $1,238.40 for Growth, and a 14-day free trial on each paid plan. The vendor's own pricing page adds two higher tiers the listing does not show: Scale at $249 a month for 2,500 submissions and 6,000 chats, and Brand at $599 a month for 6,000 submissions and 15,000 chats, both with 90 days of data, plus Enterprise on request; it advertises 20% off for yearly billing. We could not tell from either page whether Scale and Brand are billed through Shopify like the listed plans. Listed charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Brandye SAS of Bussy-Saint-Georges, France; the listing gives a launch date of 10 September 2025 and shows 12 reviews, none of them critical.

compare_with.name: RevenueHunt
compare_with.why: RevenueHunt is the established product-quiz app on Shopify and the first alternative the listing suggests. Read on its Shopify listing on 2 October 2026, it gives 100 quiz responses a month free, then $39 a month for 500, $99 for 1,000 and $199 for 2,500, with a 15-day free trial and 12 listed languages. Brandye's free plan is 100 submissions in total rather than per month, and its 500-submission tier costs $49 rather than $39. What the extra money buys is the AI side: an AI shopping assistant and AI questions on product pages, with 1,500 chats a month on that tier, which RevenueHunt's listing does not offer. A store that wants a quiz alone fits RevenueHunt; a store that wants the quiz plus an assistant answering product questions fits Brandye, at a price.
